headline: Nifty fell amid *rising volatility*
subline: A broad decline marked the day with a volatile backdrop.
hero_text: Fear gauge rose as Nifty slid. FIIs sold Rs 1,148.64 Cr, countered by DIIs buying Rs 3,201.19 Cr.

why.title: Broad Decline
why.desc: No specific catalyst identified for market decline.

sector_reasons.Private Bank: Fell with the broader financial sector
sector_reasons.Financials: Major drag due to broad selling

bonus_text: Contrasting flows with FIIs exiting and DIIs buying heavily.
movers_note_gainers: JSW Steel and ONGC managed gains despite market pressure.
movers_note_losers: Axis Bank and Bajaj Finance were major drags on the Nifty.
watch_text: Focus on Wednesday's session with key GBP CPI data and BOE speech.
lessons: Market breadth was heavily negative with declines outnumbering advances.
Financials and IT sectors led today's declines, shaping market sentiment.
Volatility surged as India VIX spiked sharply, indicating heightened caution.
Lack of clear catalysts marked today's moves among top gainers and losers.
